decision_rationale: The paper presents BioFormer as a transformer framework with generative pre-training and masked-token decoding, not just a predictor. It also describes broad, transferable biological knowledge and zero-shot/transfer use across biological tasks.
evidence_snippet: "before being decoded to predict the masked tokens from the unmasked ones"; "enabling generative pre-training on heterogeneous data"; "retrieve general biological knowledge in a zero-shot learning process"
